221. Unexpected Development (1)
"You... you son of a bitch!"
Kookan trembled. Tiliass had grabbed his neck from behind and rotated the sword that had penetrated his back once.
"Kuaack!"
Kookan screamed in pain and exploded his magic power. Thanks to this, Tiliass dodged the magic power and retrieved his sword, but the wound did not heal immediately.
Tiliass's clan, 'Biseps' originally ruled over the land of the immortality region in the demon world.

Those demons born in the immortality region had the power to suppress their opponents' abilities. Tiliass was a character who had strong authority among them, except for Bassett. Kookan kept vomiting blood and increasing the distance.
'What's going on all of a sudden? Could it be, is that demon named Tiliass a traitor of the demon world? Whatever, I can finally catch my breath.'

Just in time, he wanted to recover a little from the sensation of the red energy about to explode. Misol, who had been smashing the ice all along, also stopped moving and looked at the demons absent-mindedly with a surprised face.
"I never thought it would happen, this damned bastard... Did you betray Lord Jito? Like your trash-like brother...!"
Tiliass smirked coldly.
"Betrayal? I've never worshiped Jito once, how can you say betrayal? You guys have just been fooled until now."
"Hehe! Yes, we were fooled properly. For such a long time, you managed to hide this power... to even block the power coming from Lord Jito's genuine energy."
"We could have killed Jito. If Paelito hadn't turned."

"Even if Paelito kept helping you guys, the result would have been the same... Kuaack! Everyone pointed their fingers at you, calling you a traitor's bloodline, but I never once ignored you. Like Lord Jito, I always respected you, but how could this happen!"
"Mi, Misol! Misol!"

"Yes... there were some demons like you. The ones who acknowledged me without discrimination or prejudice. But you too, killed the members of the Biseps in front of me as if it were nothing, and tortured them. And you played along with Jito and followed that terrible ideology."
"You crazy bastard! The one who led the extermination of the Biseps was Tiliass, you! What nonsense are you talking about! The one who was called a nightmare to them...!"
"Misol!"
As Kookan said, Tiliass was the one who most violently suppressed the remaining anti-Jito forces. That's why, despite being from Biseps, he could survive and even become a demon king.
That's because Tiliass had decided to take on such a 'role' in Biseps. Tiliass looked at Kookan with dark eyes.
“When I had to torture and kill my comrades who sided with Jito… When I had to watch with a cheerful face as Jito and you guys killed
my comrades, you can never understand how I felt. Neither in life nor in death.”
For Kukan, this was an unbelievable story. Tiliath had been deceiving the demons of the underworld in such a way all this time.
As the conversation continued, Sirius bypassed the stunned Misol and approached Luna.
"First Rider, it seems there is an internal division among them."
"Yeah, it's not even middle or lower rank demons, but to have a spy among the Demon Kings, today's harvest could be even more fruitful than we thought."
"Tiliath is probably a key member of the anti-Jito forces that Orgal mentioned to Jin before. And from the way things are going now, it seems the anti-Jito forces want to join hands with us."
"They want to join hands with us? How do you know?"
"First Rider, sometimes you know too little about the world. If Tiliath didn't want to be associated with us, why would he expose his true nature right in front of us?"
"Ah, is that so?"
With Vice extinct and Tiliath exposing his true colors, Kukan had to face the fact that his chances of survival were very slim.

'While Baekgyeong is healthy, Vice is gone, and I'm seriously injured... Misol is the only one I can trust, but does this idiot have a hidden power like Tiliath? It's true that he was the strongest among us when angry... but even if Misol has power, he would have to be at least as strong as Reila for us to stand a chance.'
Shiiiiit!
A heavy and sharp purple energy was gathering around Tiliath's sword. Kukan rushed towards Misol.
"Misol! You still have a piece of Jito's flesh, right?"
Misol was the only one of the four Demon Kings who had not used the flesh. Luna had not noticed this fact due to the urgency of the battle.
"Misol?"
"Hand it over! I need to recover if we are to have any chance of survival. Due to Tiliath's power suppression, support and space jumps are impossible. Hurry up and hand it over!"
"Misol."
Misol reached into his pocket. Kukan was momentarily shocked by his gaunt action, but luckily, Tiliath was also moving slowly.

'Tiliath is probably moving cautiously because he's aware of Misol. Baekgyeong finds this situation strange, so he's just staying still. If Baekgyeong stays still for just a few more seconds, the flesh can be used sufficiently...!'

Just as he was thinking this, Kukan experienced a humiliation of being smashed into the ground, feeling a headache as if his head was about to burst. Something with tremendous power had hit Kukan's head.
The fist Misol had put into his pocket, pretending to take out the flesh, was what had hit Kukan.
"Cough…!"
Crash-!
Misol's fist hit Kukan's head again as he lay on the ground. With his head half caved in, Kukan barely managed to lift it to look up at Misol.
"I hate guys like you. You have no intellect, no will, you're just a puppet of Jito. You don't deserve to be a higher life form."
Misol, who had only said his name until now, was speaking fast but clearly. It was another shocking moment for Luna and Sirius.
"Wow… Even that guy who kept saying 'Misol, Misol'?"
"He's not an ordinary actor."
Just like Tiliath, Misol had also been deceiving the other demons until now. Misol Huwan was also a key executive of Bisepts.
"Mi, Misol. What the hell are you doing…."

"Asking that in this situation, you're really stupid. The fools are not me, it's you guys. How could I serve a world that's governed by pain? You're all terrible creatures. Jito and you guys should disappear from this world."
Kukan's last hope was gone. Before he knew it, Tiliath was looking down at Kukan, his sword, dyed purple, pointed at him.

"You'll be recorded as having died bravely in battle, Kukan Ten. Consider it a reward for treating me as an equal and trusting me all this time. Well, Jito will just be furious about losing his flesh, regardless of how you died."
"Please, spare me."
Thud!
Tiliath's sword pierced Kukan's heart. Kukan gasped for a moment before letting out a death cry, and the remaining energy in Kukan was absorbed into Tiliath through the blade.
"You did well, Tiliath. With this, I have avenged our comrades a little."
"It would have been better if we could have caught someone else of the caliber of Dailus or Reila today."
Tiliath said, pulling out a cigarette from his pocket and lighting it.
"It'll happen soon."
Luna and Sirius approached the two. Luna was still holding her weapon, but Tiliath and Misol had put theirs away.
"We should give a more detailed explanation."
"Put your weapon away first if you want to talk. Don't humans have even that much courtesy?"
"Enough, Misol. Humans won't trust us yet, so it's a natural reaction."
"It's completely unexpected from our perspective, anyway. This could all just be a show put on by that Jito, you know?"
"Show? Be careful with your words, human. We have sacrificed in the hundreds of billions for over ten thousand years, all for the sake of freedom. Have you ever seen such a show?"
"Misol, humans have difficulty understanding that. Since we are in a position to ask for help, let's not be too harsh."
"But humans need our help. Without our help, Zito can never be killed."

"Luna Runkandel, let us formally introduce ourselves again. I am Tillyas Bisekhs, a member of the Immortal Territory of the True Devil World who was a ruler and currently the only anti-Zito force Bisekhs officer left in the True Devil World. This fast-talking friend here is Misol Hwuan, who is also an officer of Bisekhs."
"So, both your family name and the name of the anti-Zito force are Bisekhs, correct?"
"That's correct."
"Introduce yourselves properly. Please have some manners. We are sentient beings, and we could potentially become allies."
"Ah... okay. I'm Luna Runkandel, from the first generation of Runkandels. Nice to meet you."
"I'm Sirius Endorma, the master of the Hidden Bow."

"As you can see, we are pretending to be non-Bisekhs, fooling Zito and the True Devil World. You just asked if it wasn't Zito's show. To be honest, I don't know how to prove our intentions any further since we've killed Kookan right in front of you. As you probably know, if we had used our full strength, we wouldn't have been able to kill Baise so easily."
Luna shrugged her shoulders.
"Well, it doesn't seem like a lie. If you two had unleashed all the power you were hiding, our master would probably have had a hard time surviving. Hmm, so you want to form an alliance with us?"
"Yes. As Misol said, you will never be able to defeat Zito without our help. Otherwise, the human world will definitely be destroyed."
"I don't like the threat of an alliance. I don't even know why you're saying that yet."
"Can you communicate with your leader, Jin Runkandel? I'll tell you the whole story in as much detail as possible."
"It's not difficult. But who is your leader?"
"Bassett Bisekhs, my older brother."
"If you want to speak directly with our master, you should also bring a suitable person. Besides, the communication device is broken. This, you made it like this, didn't you?"

As soon as Luna answered, the communication device started to resonate. Since the fight had started, Luna's side had not been able to contact them once, so the command center had been constantly requesting communication. This was the result of Tillyas using his power.

"......It takes a lot of steps for us to communicate with our brother. Because he is a demon king under Zito. But since we've exposed ourselves first, it would be nice if you could give us a little convenience. The lives of tens of billions in the True Devil World, and the lives of all humans, are at stake."
Luna made eye contact with Tillyas for a few seconds. Something was desperately trembling in his dark eyes. Eventually, Luna activated the communication device.
"This is the first generation, we are safe. There is a demon king who has requested to speak with the master, bring the master immediately."
